scoring.summary: Each requirement is MET or NOT MET in its entirety. The percentage of requirements MET is shown for progress only; Level 1 is achieved only when all 15 are MET.

rules.summary: A requirement is MET only when every applicable assessment objective is satisfied.
rules.quote: Not Met. One or more applicable objectives for the security requirement is not satisfied.

rules.summary: An objective assessed N/A counts as MET.
rules.quote: an assessment objective assessed as N/A is equivalent to the same assessment objective being assessed as MET

rules.summary: Level 1 uses the SP 800-171A objectives of the mapped requirement; wherever an objective says CUI, read it as FCI.
rules.quote: In any case where an objective addresses CUI, FCI should be substituted for CUI in the objective.

rules.summary: Requirements are scored MET or NOT MET in their entirety; there are no point values or partial credit.
rules.quote: self-assessment results are scored as MET or NOT MET in their entirety

rules.summary: No requirement may be deferred to a POA&M at Level 1.
rules.quote: A POA&M is not permitted at any time for Level 1 self-assessments.

rules.summary: Final Level 1 (Self) requires every one of the 15 requirements to be MET.
rules.quote: The OSA must complete and achieve a MET result for all security requirements specified in § 170.14(c)(2) to achieve the CMMC Status of Final Level 1 (Self).

rules.summary: The Level 1 self-assessment must be repeated every year and the results entered in SPRS.
rules.quote: the OSA must conduct a Level 1 self-assessment on an annual basis and submit the results in SPRS

rules.summary: A senior Affirming Official must affirm compliance in SPRS at the end of each self-assessment and every year.
rules.quote: At the completion of a Level 1 self-assessment and annually thereafter, the Affirming Official shall submit a CMMC affirmation attesting to continuing compliance with all requirements of the CMMC Status Level 1 (Self).

consequences.summary: Contracts that require CMMC Level 1 cannot be awarded until Level 1 (Self) is achieved and the affirmation is entered in SPRS.
consequences.quote: Prior to award of any contract or subcontract with a requirement for the CMMC Status of Level 1 (Self), OSAs must both achieve a CMMC Status of Level 1 (Self) and have submitted an affirmation of compliance into SPRS

glossary.definition: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification, the Department of Defense program that verifies contractors protect federal contract and controlled information.
Federal Contract Information: information provided by or generated for the government under a contract and not intended for public release.
Controlled Unclassified Information: government information that is not classified but must still be protected.
Federal Acquisition Regulation; clause 52.204-21 sets the basic safeguarding requirements for contractor systems holding FCI.
Supplier Performance Risk System, where contractors record assessment results and affirmations.
Plan of Action and Milestones: the documented plan for closing requirements that are not yet met. Not permitted at Level 1.
